Form a dense irregular cross-shaped core of roughly a dozen connected mid-rise blocks, with narrow alleys, small courts, storefronts, East Asian neon signs, balconies, and rooftop equipment. Suspend a red-orange futuristic vehicle above one courtyard beside an open concrete frame. Arrange roughly twenty detached high-rise towers in a loose inward-facing ring, leaving broad empty gaps around the core.
